5. Major Alternatives Considered
Alternative proposals considered in the planning stages of this proposal:
1. Upgrading Grange Avenue from Howell Avenue to I-94 into a multi-lane highway.
2. "Do-nothing" alternate.
3. Improvement of local streets and arterial highways, "no-build".
4. Rapid transit service.
5. Alternative freeway corridor locations.
In response to increased congestion on airport access routes, Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission, by federal directive, initiated a proposal linking General Mitchell Field to the nearest Interstate route. This proposal requested an access interchange at I-94 with ramp facilities to the local arterial street system. An improvement program of upgrading the closest east-west arterial street, Grange Avenue, into a multi-lane highway was to follow by the City of Milwaukee. FHWA approved this access interchange to I-94. "Corridor Descriptions", beginning on page 89 discusses this alternative location possibility along with the various freeway locations considered for the proposed highway facility.
The "do-nothing" and "no-build" alternates were considered not realistic.
